target datalayout = "e-p:64:64-i64:64-n32:64-S128"

%Pair = type { ptr, ptr }
%Nested = type { [2 x %Pair] }
%Deep = type { [2 x [2 x ptr]] }

@escaped = global ptr null
@internal_copy_slot = internal global ptr null
@internal_before_slot = internal global ptr null
@private_slot = private global ptr null
@thread_local_slot = internal thread_local global ptr null
@constant_expr_slots = internal global [2 x ptr] zeroinitializer

declare ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64)
declare noalias ptr @slot_alloc(i64)
declare ptr @plain_slot_alloc(i64)
declare void @llvm.lifetime.start.p0(i64 immarg, ptr nocapture)
declare void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr noalias nocapture writeonly, ptr noalias nocapture readonly, i64, i1 immarg)
declare void @llvm.memmove.p0.p0.i64(ptr nocapture writeonly, ptr nocapture readonly, i64, i1 immarg)
declare void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr nocapture writeonly, i8, i64, i1 immarg)
declare void @readnone_slot(ptr nocapture readnone)
declare void @readonly_slot(ptr nocapture readonly)
declare void @readwrite_slot(ptr nocapture)
declare void @plain_slot(ptr)
declare void @vararg_slot(...)
declare i32 @personality(...)

define ptr @return_slot(ptr %slot) {
entry:
  ret ptr %slot
}

define internal ptr @internal_return_slot(ptr %slot) {
entry:
  ret ptr %slot
}

define internal ptr @address_taken_return_slot(ptr %slot) {
entry:
  ret ptr %slot
}

@address_taken_return_slot_address = internal global ptr @address_taken_return_slot

define void @read_slot(ptr %slot) {
entry:
  %callee_q = load ptr, ptr %slot
  store i8 1, ptr %callee_q
  ret void
}

define void @read_slot_twice(ptr %slot) {
entry:
  %q1 = load ptr, ptr %slot
  %q2 = load ptr, ptr %slot
  store i8 1, ptr %q1
  store i8 2, ptr %q2
  ret void
}

define void @read_pair(ptr %object) {
entry:
  %field0 = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  %q0 = load ptr, ptr %field0
  %field1 = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 1
  %q1 = load ptr, ptr %field1
  store i8 1, ptr %q0
  store i8 2, ptr %q1
  ret void
}

define void @read_index(ptr %object, i64 %index) {
entry:
  %element = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %object, i64 0, i64 %index
  %indexed_q = load ptr, ptr %element
  store i8 1, ptr %indexed_q
  ret void
}

define void @overwrite_byval(ptr byval(ptr) %slot) {
entry:
  store ptr null, ptr %slot
  ret void
}

define void @invalid_slot(ptr %slot) {
entry:
  %address = ptrtoint ptr %slot to i64
  ret void
}

define void @exact_field() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Pair
  %write = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %root, ptr %write
  %read = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  %q = load ptr, ptr %read
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @disjoint_field() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Pair
  %first = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %root, ptr %first
  %second = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 1
  store ptr null, ptr %second
  %q = load ptr, ptr %second
  store ptr %q, ptr @escaped
  ret void
}

define void @overlapping_whole_read() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Pair
  %field = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %root, ptr %field
  %whole = load %Pair, ptr %object
  %q = extractvalue %Pair %whole, 0
  store ptr %q, ptr @escaped
  ret void
}

define void @overwritten_before_read() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Pair
  %write = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %root, ptr %write
  store ptr null, ptr %write
  %q = load ptr, ptr %write
  store ptr %q, ptr @escaped
  ret void
}

define void @bitcast_destination() {

  store ptr %root, ptr %alias

  ret void

define void @addrspacecast_destination() {

define void @selected_destination(i1 %condition) {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %slot1 = alloca ptr
  %slot2 = alloca ptr
  %selected = select i1 %condition, ptr %slot1, ptr %slot2
  store ptr %root, ptr %selected
  %q1 = load ptr, ptr %slot1
  %q2 = load ptr, ptr %slot2
  store i8 1, ptr %q1
  store i8 2, ptr %q2
  ret void
}

define void @phi_destination(i1 %condition) {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %slot1 = alloca ptr
  %slot2 = alloca ptr
  br i1 %condition, label %left, label %right

left:
  br label %merge

right:
  br label %merge

merge:
  %selected = phi ptr [ %slot1, %left ], [ %slot2, %right ]
  store ptr %root, ptr %selected
  %q1 = load ptr, ptr %slot1
  %q2 = load ptr, ptr %slot2
  store i8 1, ptr %q1
  store i8 2, ptr %q2
  ret void
}

define void @loop_invariant_phi(i1 %repeat) {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca ptr
  br label %loop

loop:
  %alias = phi ptr [ %object, %entry ], [ %alias, %loop ]
  store ptr %root, ptr %alias
  br i1 %repeat, label %loop, label %exit

exit:
  %q = load ptr, ptr %object
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @loop_variant_phi(i1 %repeat) {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca [2 x ptr]
  br label %loop

loop:
  %alias = phi ptr [ %object, %entry ], [ %next, %loop ]
  %next = getelementptr ptr, ptr %alias, i64 1
  store ptr %root, ptr %alias
  br i1 %repeat, label %loop, label %exit

exit:
  %q = load ptr, ptr %object
  ret void
}

  %alias = freeze ptr %object
  %q = load ptr, ptr %alias
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @invoke_callee_reader() personality ptr @personality {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca ptr
  store ptr %root, ptr %object
  invoke void @read_slot(ptr %object) to label %done unwind label %unwind

done:
  ret void

unwind:
  %landing = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
    cleanup
  resume { ptr, i32 } %landing
}

}

define void @finite_select_offset(i1 %condition) {

  ret void
}

define void @finite_phi_offset(i1 %condition) {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %array = alloca [2 x ptr]
  br i1 %condition, label %left, label %right

left:
  br label %merge

right:
  br label %merge

merge:
  %index = phi i64 [ 0, %left ], [ 1, %right ]
  %element = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 %index
  store ptr %root, ptr %element
  %q = load ptr, ptr %element
  ret void
}

define void @chained_constant_offsets() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %array = alloca [4 x ptr]
  %base = getelementptr [4 x ptr], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 1
  %write = getelementptr ptr, ptr %base, i64 1
  store ptr %root, ptr %write
  %read = getelementptr [4 x ptr], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 2
  %q = load ptr, ptr %read
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @nested_finite_offsets(i1 %left, i1 %right) {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Deep
  %row = select i1 %left, i64 0, i64 1
  %column = select i1 %right, i64 0, i64 1
  %element = getelementptr %Deep, ptr %object, i64 0, i32 0, i64 %row, i64 %column
  store ptr %root, ptr %element
  %q = load ptr, ptr %element
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @select_partial_overlap(i1 %condition) {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %array = alloca [2 x ptr]
  %element0 = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 0
  %element1 = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 1
  store ptr %root, ptr %element0
  %selected = select i1 %condition, ptr %element0, ptr %element1
  %q = load ptr, ptr %selected
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @phi_partial_overlap(i1 %condition) {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %array = alloca [2 x ptr]
  %element0 = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 0
  %element1 = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 1
  store ptr %root, ptr %element0
  br i1 %condition, label %left, label %right

left:
  br label %merge

right:
  br label %merge

merge:
  %selected = phi ptr [ %element0, %left ], [ %element1, %right ]
  %q = load ptr, ptr %selected
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @same_callee_loads() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca ptr
  store ptr %root, ptr %object
  call void @read_slot_twice(ptr %object)
  ret void
}

define void @different_callee_loads() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Pair
  %field0 = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %root, ptr %field0
  call void @read_pair(ptr %object)
  ret void
}

define void @constant_callsite_index() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca [2 x ptr]
  %element = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %object, i64 0, i64 1
  store ptr %root, ptr %element
  call void @read_index(ptr %object, i64 1)
  ret void
}

define void @arithmetic_index() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca [2 x ptr]
  %index = add i64 0, 1
  %element = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %object, i64 0, i64 %index
  store ptr %root, ptr %element
  %q = load ptr, ptr %element
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @loaded_index() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca [2 x ptr]
  %index_address = alloca i64
  store i64 1, ptr %index_address
  %index = load i64, ptr %index_address
  %element = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %object, i64 0, i64 %index
  store ptr %root, ptr %element
  %q = load ptr, ptr %element
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @constant_expr_destination() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  store ptr %root, ptr getelementptr ([2 x ptr], ptr @constant_expr_slots, i64 0, i64 1)
  %q = load ptr, ptr getelementptr ([2 x ptr], ptr @constant_expr_slots, i64 0, i64 1)
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @byval_write_isolated() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca ptr
  store ptr %root, ptr %object
  call void @overwrite_byval(ptr byval(ptr) %object)
  %q = load ptr, ptr %object
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}
